recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If a future generated build omits binary-f006, treat that as a build/regeneration issue rather than a missing current source edit.
issue_request: FHIR-6107 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient correction reporting a broken image reference to @binary/f006 and saying the target image was in source but not being processed into an example.
initial_application: The issue was applied in old SVN-backed history: git-svn revision 5980, commit 835d5da17a0836d57031d5f55082e8c54e6bbfb5, is titled '#6107 - add missing binary'; the immediately following revision 5981 commit dc185af71d3c5608b8b21d4173d999424cda7cc8 added source/binary/binary-f006.xml as the missed file.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps both Patient and Binary active in the current build. The current Patient example references Binary/f006, the Binary/f006 XML source exists with image/jpeg content, and list-Binary-examples.xml lists it as the Patient Photo example. Related FHIR-6333 covers capitalization/removal of the obsolete @ marker on the same URL and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current core source change is needed.
